summary: Retest of UG Campus App after fixes for the two HIGH bugs plus the minor label + new timetable-to-chat feature. All four items verified PASS on 390x844 viewport. (1) Planner Add-Task modal now renders as a proper bottom sheet overlay: 'planner-modal-save' bounding box y=694, bottom=744 within 844 viewport (fully in-view). Save creates the task ('TEST_task_retest' appeared in agenda), CANCEL closes the modal, backdrop tap closes the modal. (2) Sign-out from Today tab (profile-signout) now redirects to /login and the login screen (login-email-input) renders. (3) Bottom tab label reads 'RESOURCES' (previously 'LIBRARY'). (4) Timetable rows are Pressable — tapping timetable-entry-CSCD 311-0 navigated to /chat/bb8a0f9b-9cab-4df3-a138-15ba4b11796f and the chat screen mounted (chat-back / chat-input / chat-send visible; existing 'TEST hello group' message rendered). Backend was not re-run (previously 20/20 green, no changes to backend). No new react-native/expo deprecations detected in the touched files.
critical_code_review_comments: planner.tsx overlay uses a plain absolutely-positioned View instead of react-native Modal component. It works on web (verified) and satisfies the fix, but on native Android hardware-back-press won't dismiss it. Optional: swap to <Modal transparent animationType='slide' onRequestClose={()=>setModal(false)}> for parity with Android back-button behaviour.

timetable.tsx: Pressable rows now navigate to /chat/{course_id}. No visual affordance (chevron / hint text) that the row is tappable; consider a small caret icon or a subtle 'tap to chat' hint for discoverability.

AuthContext.signOut uses the imported `router` singleton from expo-router; that works but breaks testability. useRouter() inside components is preferred — however the fix as-is is correct and functional.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ task ('TEST_task_retest') was created for date 2026-07-12 via the planner flow. Safe to leave; can be manually deleted via the trash icon on the agenda row.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 retest is fully green for the two HIGH fixes (planner modal, signout redirect) and the two minor items (Resources label, timetable-row -> chat). Backend was intentionally not re-run (unchanged since iteration_1 20/20). If future changes touch server.py, re-run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_ug_campus.py before frontend retests.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — both prior HIGH bugs are resolved. RCA is documented in iteration_1.json.
